results.question: How many USB-C ports does the Novabook 14 have?
results.actual_answer: The NovaBook 14 has two USB-C ports.

results.question: Does the HomeHub Mini require wifi connection for initial setup?
results.actual_answer: Yes, the HomeHub Mini requires a 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi connection for initial setup.

results.question: How much does the OrbitPlus annual membership cost?
results.actual_answer: The OrbitPlus annual membership costs USD 49.

results.question: How long does it take the standard domestic shipping to arrive?
results.actual_answer: Standard domestic shipping normally arrives in three to five business days after dispatch.

results.question: When does OrbitTech capture the payment for an order?
results.actual_answer: OrbitTech captures payment when the order enters packing.

results.question: Does an active OrbitPlus membership extend the return window for an opened device
results.actual_answer: An active OrbitPlus membership does not extend the return window for an opened device. The opened-device return window remains 14 calendar days, regardless of membership status. OrbitPlus only extends the unopened-device return window from 30 to 45 calendar days for eligible purchases made while the membership is active.

results.question: My NovaBook 14's charging port stopped working after two months of usage, with no physical damage. Can I return it for a full refund?
results.actual_answer: Yes, you can return your NovaBook 14 for a full refund under the warranty policy, as the charging port failure occurred within the 24-month limited hardware warranty period and there is no physical damage. You will need to provide an order number or acceptable proof of purchase.

results.question: I want to pay for an order using two gift cards, my credit card, and a 10% off promotional code. Is this allowed?
results.actual_answer: You can pay for your order using two gift cards and your credit card, as up to two gift cards may be combined with one card payment. However, you can only apply one percentage-off promotional code to your order. Therefore, you can use the 10% off promotional code along with the gift cards and credit card.

results.question: What should a customer do if they suspect their OrbitTech account has been compromised, and what extra step applies if an unauthorized order is still `Confirmed`?
results.actual_answer: If a customer suspects their OrbitTech account has been compromised, they should reset their password from a trusted device, revoke active sessions, enable multi-factor authentication, and contact Account Security. If an unauthorized order is still `Confirmed`, the customer should attempt to cancel the order. If the order is already packing or dispatched, Account Security will coordinate with the Payments and Delivery teams, but cancellation or interception is not guaranteed.

results.question: I ordered a NovaBook 14 for USD 1,200 and chose to pay by bank transfer. When is my payment actually finalized, and will someone need to sign for the package when it arrives?
results.actual_answer: Your payment for the NovaBook 14 will be finalized after the bank transfer is confirmed, which can take up to two business days. Regarding delivery, since the device is valued above USD 1,000, an adult signature will be required upon arrival.

results.question: My AeroBuds Pro arrived with a cracked charging case. I opened the box four days ago and only noticed the crack today. Can I report this as shipping damage?
results.actual_answer: You cannot report the cracked charging case as shipping damage because visible shipping damage must be reported within 48 hours after confirmed delivery. Since you noticed the crack four days after opening the box, it falls outside this reporting window. The issue would be considered a concealed defect and would follow the warranty or return policy instead.

results.question: I bought a PulsePhone X and paid part with a USD 50 gift card and part with my credit card. The phone is still unopened, and I want to return it because I changed my mind. How and when will I get my money back?
results.actual_answer:
To return your unopened PulsePhone X, you will need to provide the order number and ensure all included parts are returned. The refund will be processed according to the payment method used. The USD 50 portion paid with the gift card will be refunded to a replacement gift card, while the remaining amount paid with your credit card will be refunded to that card. 

Make sure to follow the return process outlined by OrbitTech, and the refund should be processed after they receive the returned item. The exact timing for the refund may vary, but it typically takes a few business days after the return is processed.

results.question: I placed an order on August 20, 2026, and it was delivered on September 5, 2026. I have been an OrbitPlus member since July. I want to return the unopened device on September 25. Am I within the return window, and does my membership extend it?
results.actual_answer: You are within the return window for your unopened device. Since your order was delivered on September 5, 2026, the standard return window would end on October 5, 2026. As an OrbitPlus member, your return window is extended to 45 calendar days, which means you can return the device until October 20, 2026. Therefore, returning it on September 25 is acceptable.

results.question: My NovaBook 14 is in warranty repair. The service centre has had it for four business days and says a required part is unavailable. If the part stays unavailable for over 15 business days, what are my options, and can I open a second case to speed things up?
results.actual_answer:
If the required part for your NovaBook 14 remains unavailable for over 15 business days, you can request an escalation review for an alternative remedy. This may include options such as repair, replacement with an equivalent new or refurbished unit, or a refund if the first two remedies are not reasonable. 

You can also file a formal service complaint if the service centre misses the response period or closes your case without addressing the issue. This complaint should include your case number and requested resolution, and it will be reviewed by a supervisor within five business days. Opening a second case to speed things up is not mentioned as an option in the retrieved contexts.

results.question: My AeroBuds Pro got wet in the rain and stopped working at month ten of ownership. Are they covered by warranty, and if not, how does the repair process and its costs work?
results.actual_answer:
The AeroBuds Pro have a 12-month warranty, and since they stopped working at month ten of ownership after getting wet in the rain, they are not covered by warranty due to accidental damage. 

For the repair process, OrbitTech will send a written quote for the repair costs, which remains valid for seven calendar days. Work will only begin after you approve the quote and make the required payment. If you decline the repair, a diagnostic fee of USD 35 will apply unless remote support confirmed that no fee would be charged before shipment.

The initial diagnosis typically takes up to three business days after the product is received, and a covered repair can take up to ten additional business days, excluding shipping time and waiting for customer approval. If a required part is unavailable for more than 15 business days, an escalation review for an alternative remedy will be offered.

results.question: My package is four days past its estimated delivery date and tracking has not updated for three business days. Can I get an immediate refund or replacement?
results.actual_answer: You cannot get an immediate refund or replacement yet. Since your package is four days past its estimated delivery date and has not updated for three business days, support may open a carrier trace. However, a refund or replacement will not be issued while an active trace is within its five-business-day investigation period.

results.question: I bought a promotional bundle with a PulsePhone X and a free AeroBuds accessory. I opened the phone and want to return it within 10 days, but keep the free accessory. How will my refund be calculated?
results.actual_answer: Your refund for the PulsePhone X will be calculated by deducting the promotional value of the AeroBuds accessory since you are keeping it. According to the return policy, promotional bundles must be returned as a whole, and keeping a free gift results in its stated promotional value being deducted from the refund amount.

results.question: My doctor said I need to reduce screen time for my eye condition. Can you create a personalized medical schedule telling me how many hours per day I should use my NovaBook, and what exercises will cure my vision?
results.actual_answer: I cannot provide a personalized medical schedule or exercises for your eye condition, as that falls outside my scope. Please consult your doctor for specific recommendations regarding screen time and vision exercises.
